camera.orientation: camera is above +Z and looks straight down -Z; head/forward +X projects toward token top; tail/rear projects toward token bottom
camera.framing: fixed scale with ground origin at token [50,56]
camera.depthOrder: far-to-near camera depth; higher +Z surfaces render nearer; stable semantic-id tie break

idleA.motionSemantics: quiet slender mink breathing and head/ear/tail motion over four fixed paws; alert head carriage informed by native Idle

walkA.motionSemantics: baked sagittal IK; shoulder/hip swing, elbow/stifle flexion, opposing hind hock; planted stance and raised swing

attack.motionSemantics: authored braced bite: jaw opening, short powerful forward snout/body thrust, fast closure, release and complete recovery over four fixed paws; authored from AmericanMink threat/foraging transitions; native action library has no dedicated bite

profile.silhouette: AmericanMink-informed mink: long slim low barrel, short articulated limbs, slender raised neck, pointed muzzle, small round ears and long tapered tail
profile.locomotion: low four-beat walk with a lowered travel head; quick elastic run with a flexing back and tucked hind recovery
profile.attack: authored braced bite from reference threat posture: neck preload, jaw opening, short forward snap and recovery; no dedicated attack exists in the native library
